perks.name: Hip-Fire Grip
perks.desc: Increases accuracy, stability, and precision hit targeting when firing from the hip.

perks.name: Subsistence
perks.desc: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Dynamic Sway Reduction
perks.desc: Improves accuracy and stability while continuously holding down the trigger.

perks.name: Lead From Light
perks.desc: Picking up an Orb of Power causes your next final blow with this weapon to grant bonus Special ammo meter progress.

perks.name: Rimestealer
perks.desc: Destroying a Stasis crystal or defeating a frozen target with this weapon grants you Frost Armor.

perks.name: Attrition Orbs
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.

perks.name: Adrenaline Junkie
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon.

perks.name: Desperate Measures
perks.desc: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.

perks.name: Collective Pugilism
perks.desc:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of melee energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

perks.name: Target Lock
perks.desc: Damage increases the longer this weapon remains on a target.

perks.name: Crystalline Corpsebloom
perks.desc: Rapid final blows spawn a [Stasis] Stasis crystal near the victim's location.

perks.name: Problem Solver
perks.desc:
Dealing sustained damage to Champion, miniboss, or boss combatants exhausts them and grants this weapon handling and reload speed.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.

perks.name: Vanguard Determination
perks.desc: After using your class ability, final blows with this weapon grant you bonus damage resistance.

perks.name: Tenacity
perks.desc: When targets are nearby, final blows grant weapon damage, reload speed, and handling until the wielder's death.

notes: Inspired by @ImpetusAlways, @Saint_Kabr and @CourtProjects (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-God PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing minor adds in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content, particularly on Stasis builds. Seraphine Haze is an aggressive SMG, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic tiering spreadsheet https://linktr.ee/TheAegisRelic. The stats are good by comparison with its peers, and are helped further at Tier 4/5 when barrel and magazine perks are enhanced - see https://d2foundry.gg/w/1524387902 for how the weapon stats impact in-game performance. From the @Mossy-Max spreadsheet at https://www.destiny2.science/ base Magazine size is 29 (max 36). With a Recoil Direction of 96 and very compressed range, or maybe look for a touch of extra Stability or Handling with the barrel perk and then for the magazine perk, something to help with Reload Speed. For Stasis synergy, in the first trait perk column there's Rimestealer, which generates a stack (2 stacks when enhanced) of Frost Armor on shattering a Stasis crystal or killing a frozen enemy - improved further with Whisper of Rime. In the second column, pair this with Crystalline Corpsebloom which procs on a kill to provide a 4s buff - kills with the buff active generate a stasis seeker which travels 3m and spawns a medium Stasis crystal (large when enhanced) to shatter for AoE damage and proc subclass fragment effects. For the Origin Trait, there's a choice of three - first, Problem Solver, which is very good for PvE when facing yellow bars - 7 hits will apply Exhaust to an enemy, reducing damage output to ×0.75 for a 5s and grant +50 to Reload Speed and Handling for 10s (12s when enhanced) - both buffs are refreshable. There's also Vanguard Vindication to provide up to ×3 stacks of ×0.98/0.96/0.94 damage reduction for a refreshable 10s (12.5s when enhanced), on kills within 20s of using a class ability. Finally there's Tenacity which stacks up to ×20 on kills, providing +2.5 Handling and Reload Speed and an extra 0.5% damage per stack (max +50 Handling and Reload, and ×1.1 damage boost) until you die. Recommended MW: Stability or Handling, with your preferred choice of mod/enhanced mod to boost mag size, weapon stats, ammo regeneration, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.
